name: Orkla ASA
summary: Orkla ASA operates as an industrial investment company within brands and consumer-oriented businesses worldwide. It offers decorative paints, marine coatings, protective coatings, and powder coatings; frozen pizza, condiments, bread toppings, and ready-to-eat meals; bakery, ice cream, and plant-based products; and confectionery, biscuits, and salty snacks.
